title: US forces enter Iran by..?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if active US military personnel physically enter Iran at any point by the listed date (ET). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Military special operation forces will qualify, however intelligence operatives will not count.

US military personnel must physically enter the terrestrial territory of Iran to qualify. Entering Iran's maritime or aerial territory will not count.

Military contractors, military advisors, or high-ranking US service members entering Iran for diplomatic purposes (and their accompanying entourage) will not qualify.

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Amid ongoing US-Israeli airstrikes under Operation Epic Fury—launched February 28 targeting Iran's missile, nuclear, and command infrastructure—no US ground forces have entered Iranian territory over a month into the conflict, prioritizing air superiority and degradation of retaliatory capabilities. Recent Pentagon reinforcements, including Marine Expeditionary Units, 82nd Airborne paratroopers, and over 50,000 troops amassed in the region, signal preparations for potential ground operations, as noted in reports from the past week. Diplomatic channels persist via Omani mediators, with Iran reviewing a US proposal to end hostilities amid mutual escalation signals; traders weigh these against procedural hurdles to invasion and upcoming talks that could avert boots-on-the-ground entry.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent California primary polling from mid-March showing Governor Gavin Newsom commanding a double-digit lead over Kamala Harris among state Democrats has driven trader consensus positioning him as the clear early favorite in the wide-open 2028 Democratic presidential nomination field. His national profile from prior Trump-era debates and executive experience differentiates him from progressives like Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, who appeals to the party's left flank, and emerging governors or senators such as Josh Shapiro or Mark Kelly eyeing swing-state paths. With no outcome exceeding 25% implied probability, support consolidation could accelerate via strong 2026 midterm performances, superior fundraising, party leader endorsements, or shifts in national polling averages as primaries near.

McConnell (hamstring), Pascal Siakam (knee), and Andrew Nembhard (back) listed as questionable or doubtful per the latest injury report. Miami (39-35, 10th in East play-in hunt) counters with healthier depth despite Norman Powell (illness) and Terry Rozier (personal) out, leaning on Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro's recent form; their motivation for playoff seeding contrasts Pacers' meaningless slate, though mixed head-to-head history adds upset potential.

eventMetadata.context_description: No. 2 seed Connecticut Huskies pulled off a stunning 73-72 Elite Eight upset over No. 1 overall seed Duke Blue Devils in the 2026 NCAA Tournament, erasing a 19-point deficit with a game-winning bucket at 0.4 seconds, propelled by Tarris Reed Jr.'s 20 points and Alex Karaban's 17 to reach the Final Four. Pre-game trader consensus leaned Duke due to their 35-win dominance (81.9 PPG, +18.5 margin), Caleb Foster's surprise return from a foot fracture, and Patrick Ngongba II's availability after injury concerns. UConn navigated point guard Silas Demary Jr.'s ankle issue and a gritty 67-63 Sweet 16 win over Michigan State, building on a prior championship upset of Duke for resilience in March Madness pressure.

The 2026 midterms and Iran resolution trajectory will likely determine separation in this fragmented field ahead of primaries.

eventMetadata.context_description: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. leads trader consensus at 49% implied probability for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, driven by his high-profile role spearheading the Make America Healthy Again health reforms and strong early prediction market performance amid reports of administrative competence surprising even skeptics. Vice President J.D. Vance holds 36.6% as the heir apparent but has slipped in recent straw polls, including a CPAC survey where he edged Marco Rubio 53%-35%, hampered by perceived foreign policy stumbles like the Iran escalation. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's 20.6% reflects surging momentum from diplomatic successes and donor cheers over Vance in a Mar-a-Lago meeting with President Trump, narrowing the field in this open primary post-Trump's term limit. Midterm results and 2027 primaries loom as key catalysts.

title: Dota 2: Tundra Esports vs Team Yandex (BO5) - ESL One Birmingham Playoffs
description:
This market refers to the Dota 2 Grand final match between Tundra Esports and Team Yandex in the ESL One Birmingham Playoffs, initially scheduled for March 29 at 11:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Tundra Esports" if Tundra Esports win the match against Team Yandex.

This market will resolve to "Team Yandex" if Team Yandex win the match against Tundra Esports.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://www.dotabuff.com. However, if https://www.dotabuff.com has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

markets.question: Game 1: Ends in Daytime?
markets.description:
This market is about whether Game 1 ends during the daytime phase of the Dota 2 day/night cycle. In Dota 2, the day/night cycle alternates every 5 minutes (daytime runs from 0:00–5:00, 10:00–15:00, 20:00–25:00, and so on, while nighttime runs from 5:00–10:00, 15:00–20:00, 25:00–30:00, and so on).

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the game-ending action (Ancient destruction or midgame forfeit) occurs during a daytime phase of the base in-game clock. This market will resolve to "No" if the game ends during a nighttime phase. Temporary nighttime effects caused by hero abilities (e.g., Night Stalker's Dark Ascension) do not affect resolution, only the base day/night cycle timer is considered.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://www.dotabuff.com. However, if https://www.dotabuff.com has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

This market is about whether any player achieves an Ultra Kill during Game 4. In Dota 2, an Ultra Kill occurs when a single player kills 4 enemy heroes in rapid succession without dying.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player on either team achieves an Ultra Kill during Game 4. This market will resolve to "No" if no player achieves an Ultra Kill. A Rampage (5 kills in rapid succession) also counts as an Ultra Kill having occurred for the purposes of this market.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 4 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 4 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 4 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 4 begins but is not completed and ends via forfeit, this market will resolve based on whether an Ultra Kill occurred prior to stoppage. If no Ultra Kill occurred, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 4 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://www.dotabuff.com. However, if https://www.dotabuff.com has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: Tundra Esports enters the ESL One Birmingham 2026 playoffs BO5 matchup against Team Yandex with strong momentum from a dominant 2-0 upper bracket final win over the same opponent just days ago, following their group stage 1-1 draw, amid a red-hot season featuring four titles including the recent DreamLeague Season 28 victory over Aurora Gaming. The UK-based Tundra benefits from home crowd energy in Birmingham, leveraging stable roster execution in the current patch's aggressive meta favoring quick map rotations and high-ground pushes. Team Yandex, the rising CIS squad rebuilt from Cyber Goose in mid-2025 with carries like watson and support Saksa, clawed through the lower bracket to force this grand final rematch, highlighting resilient drafting and late-game comebacks but facing head-to-head deficits; key factors include early map control, hero pool overlaps, and fatigue from extended playoffs play.

eventMetadata.context_description: Boston Celtics head to Charlotte on a lengthy injury report that rules out Jaylen Brown (left Achilles tendinitis) and Derrick White (right knee contusion), with Jayson Tatum (right Achilles management) and Neemias Queta (right thumb strain) questionable, severely testing their bench depth despite a 49-24 record and second-place Eastern Conference standing. The Hornets (39-35), securing a play-in spot, hold a 1-0 season edge after a 118-89 blowout at Boston on March 4, fueled by league-leading made threes (1,210) and rookie Kon Knueppel’s hot shooting, though they face back-to-back fatigue following a loss to Philadelphia. Tatum’s status and Pritchard’s recent scoring loom large for Boston’s road test.
